entities.summary: Mulla Abu Bakr Effendi, also Mulla Effendi (also spelled Mala Fandi,, , Abu Bakr IV, or Küçük Mulla, was a senior Islamic philosopher, scholar, astronomer, politician, and a prominent personality from Erbil, Ottoman Iraq.
